evidence.title: OpusClip: #1 AI video clipping and editing tool

name: OpusClip
summary: AI video tool that cuts long videos into short vertical clips with captions and reframing, then posts them to social platforms.
description: An AI clipping and editing platform: drop a YouTube, Twitch, Zoom or Google Drive link (or upload a file) and it picks highlight moments, adds animated captions, reframes to any aspect ratio with object tracking and can auto-post to YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels. Agent Opus adds prompt-to-video generation with avatars, voiceover and motion graphics; a public REST API and a native MCP server (29 tools) drive the pipeline from agents and code.
contains: ClipAnything model clips any video type, not only podcasts
AI reframing with object tracking, plus manual tracking
auto-post to YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels
Agent Opus: prompt-to-video agent with AI avatars, voiceover and motion graphics
native MCP server with 29 tools and a public REST API
free tier; Starter $15/mo, Pro $29/mo ($14.50 billed yearly), Business plan
site figures: 20M+ creators, 440M+ clips created, 160B+ views
